$comment: F2a (plan E-6, BR-2): the rules both portal-screen readers follow, so they cannot drift: tools/read_portal_capture.py (saved pages, Python) and extension/src/reader.ts (the live page, in the browser). Patterns are written for both regex engines: ASCII classes only (no \w, no \b), compiled with re.ASCII in Python. A change here changes both readers; the conformance test (tests/check_forms_f2a.ts) reads every fixture with both.

client_data.what: a long number (an identifier such as a UCI or an application number)

label_answer.what: its label has text after the colon, which may be an answer shown as text
